[line]
[heading]Description / 完整介绍[/heading]
中文介绍
[heading]猫猫法杖[/heading]
挥动猫猫法杖，让一群魔法小猫陪你四处冒险。它们会跟着你穿过城镇、农场和矿洞；闲下来时会坐下、舔爪、睡觉或在附近散步。遇到怪物时，它们会炸起毛、跳向敌人，在翻腾的云团中替你战斗。
获得方式
你会收到阿比盖尔寄来的一封信。她想把一件特别的礼物送给同样喜欢小猫的你——法师曾经送给她的生日礼物，猫猫法杖。
当天前往阿比盖尔的房间并与她交谈即可领取。如果当天没空，之后随时找到她也可以拿到法杖。
操作
[list]
[*]手持猫猫法杖左键：挥动法杖，伴随两声清脆的叮叮声，在身边召唤一只随机外观的小猫。[/*]
[*]手持猫猫法杖右键：让自己召唤的所有小猫消失。[/*]
[*][code]Alt + F9[/code]：打开设置界面。[/*]
[/list]每次召唤间隔为 0.3 秒。小猫会出现在附近合适的位置，不会落进水里、墙里或地图外。
一起冒险
[list]
[*]小猫会跟随你移动，并陪你换地图、进入新矿层或传送。[/*]
[*]你停下五秒后，小猫才会坐下、舔爪、睡觉或在附近闲逛；你重新出发时，它们也会继续跟上。[/*]
[*]距离过远时，小猫会加快速度追赶；骑马或提高移动速度时，它们也会努力跟上。[/*]
[*]遇到附近的怪物后，小猫会炸毛跳着追上去并投入战斗。打倒目标后，如果附近还有怪物，它们会继续迎战下一个。[/*]
[*]多只猫可以一起围攻同一个怪物，战斗会显示为一个热闹的云团。面对大型怪物时云团也会变大，飞蛇会在攻击中痛苦扭动。[/*]
[*]小猫不会挡住玩家，并会尽量给门口、楼梯和狭窄通道留出空间。[/*]
[*]召唤的小猫不会死亡，也不能被抚摸或戴帽子。[/*]
[/list]自定义设置
每名玩家都可以通过 
[code]Alt + F9[/code] 单独调整：
[list]
[*]最多召唤数量；[/*]
[*]单只猫造成的伤害；[/*]
[*]小猫存在时间：现实秒数、游戏天数或永久。[/*]
[/list]默认值为最多 8 只、每只 10 点伤害、存在 60 秒。
多人游戏
每名玩家拥有自己的小猫和设置，可以分别使用自己喜欢的参数。联机时，房主和所有加入者都需要安装相同版本的模组。
安装要求
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6；[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 或更高版本。[/*]
[/list]解压下载文件，将完整的模组文件夹放入 Stardew Valley 的 
[code]Mods[/code] 文件夹，然后通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。
语言版本
下载区提供两个完整版本：
[list]
[*][code]Cat Wand[/code]：英语版；[/*]
[*][code]猫猫法杖[/code]：简体中文版。[/*]
[/list]每台电脑只安装其中一个版本，请勿同时安装。不同联机玩家可以按照自己的语言偏好选择版本。
[line]
English Description
[heading]Cat Wand[/heading]
Wield the Cat Wand and bring a little band of magical cats along on your adventures. They follow you through town, across the farm, and into the mines. When things are quiet, they sit, groom, sleep, or wander nearby. When monsters appear, they bristle, leap into battle, and disappear with their target into a lively cartoon fight cloud.
How to Get the Wand
You will receive a letter from Abigail. She has a special gift for a fellow cat lover: the Cat Wand, a birthday present she once received from the Wizard.
Visit Abigail in her room and talk to her to receive it. If you are busy that day, you can come back and collect the wand from her later.
Controls
[list]
[*]Left-click while holding the Cat Wand: swing it, hear two bright chimes, and summon one randomly styled cat nearby.[/*]
[*]Right-click while holding the Cat Wand: dismiss all cats you have summoned.[/*]
[*][code]Alt + F9[/code]: open the settings menu.[/*]
[/list]The summon cooldown is 0.3 seconds. Cats appear in suitable nearby spots and will not spawn in water, inside walls, or outside the map.
Adventures with Your Cats
[list]
[*]Cats follow you between locations, mine floors, and teleports.[/*]
[*]After you stand still for five seconds, they may sit, groom, sleep, or wander nearby. They get moving again when you do.[/*]
[*]If they fall behind, they run faster to catch up. They also try to keep pace when you ride a horse or use movement-speed bonuses.[/*]
[*]When a nearby monster appears, the cats bristle and hop after it before joining the fight. Once it is defeated, they move on to another nearby monster if one is available.[/*]
[*]Several cats can gang up on the same monster inside one lively fight cloud. The cloud grows for larger enemies, while flying serpents visibly writhe under attack.[/*]
[*]Cats do not block the player and try to leave room around doors, stairs, and narrow passages.[/*]
[*]Summoned cats cannot die and cannot be petted or given hats.[/*]
[/list]Custom Settings
Each player can press 
[code]Alt + F9[/code] and independently configure:
[list]
[*]maximum summoned cats;[/*]
[*]damage dealt by each cat;[/*]
[*]cat lifetime in real-time seconds, in-game days, or permanently.[/*]
[/list]The defaults are 8 cats, 10 damage per cat, and a 60-second lifetime.
Multiplayer
Every player has their own cats and settings, so each person can choose the values they prefer. The host and every farmhand must install the same mod version.
Requirements and Installation
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6;[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later.[/*]
[/list]Extract the archive, place the complete mod folder inside Stardew Valley's 
[code]Mods[/code] folder, and launch the game through SMAPI.
Language Editions
The Files tab contains two complete editions:
[list]
[*][code]Cat Wand[/code]: English;[/*]
[*][code]猫猫法杖[/code]: Simplified Chinese.[/*]
[/list]Install only one edition on each computer. Different players in the same multiplayer game may choose the edition they prefer.
